Method of Attack: Modular backdoor malware targeting Oracle Micros Hospitality RES 3700 PoS systems
Steals passwords for PoS system databases by decrypting them from Windows registry values
Uses downloadable modules to extend features such as decrypting database passwords, scanning IP addresses, enumerating running processes
Intercepts and decrypts PoS database passwords using a custom algorithm
Scans specified IP addresses to gather info about Micros PoS environment
Enumerates running processes and their modules
Impacted Systems: Oracle Micros Hospitality RES 3700 point-of-sale systems
Attack Vector: Modular architecture with initial dropper, persistent loader, main module, networking module, and downloadable components
